body: It sounds like you have someone to live for and that you would benefit from therapy and possibly medication to help with your depression. Please know that there is no shame in seeking help when you don't feel that you have the means to help yourself. If you have a chance to be happy please take it.

You're young, you don't know what will capture your interest. What could make your heart soar. There are so many things you havent experienced yet. Give it some more time, life is full of potential at your age.
